title: Dateline NBC
description:
S27 E14 — The Alibi
The homicide of private first class soldier and young mother Karlyn Ramirez; a glimpse into the FBI's crime lab and an in-depth look at how multiple agencies uncovered a plot that spanned several states and prompted suspicions of espionage.

title: Dateline NBC
description:
S27 E20 — What They Saw
The friends of a Georgia father accused of murdering his ex-wife come together to prove he is innocent, while prosecutors count on his young children to testify against him.

title: Dateline NBC
description:
S27 E35 — Facing the Music
The murder of a young schoolteacher in Pennsylvania goes unsolved for years, but investigators discover a new tool that may finally help unlock the murderer's identity.

title: Dateline NBC
description:
S26 E12 — The Women & Dirty John
A look at the case of con man John Meehan, including interviews with his wife and her daughter, his ex-wife, law enforcement officers, and the Los Angeles Times reporter who shined a spotlight on the story.

title: Dateline NBC
description:
S27 E52 — Hinckley: Diary of a Dangerous Mind
Recently uncovered pages from John Hinckley Jr.'s diary, which he began writing after he was arrested for trying to assassinate President Ronald Reagan; an interview with the officer who questioned Hinckley after the attempted assassination.

title: Dateline NBC
description:

title: Dateline NBC
